purpose: Identify a reproducible change in support transfer that distinguishes natural backward starts from common stalls before testing another intervention.
pair_scope: Original backward command, fixed official ONNX, same physics. Use naturally delayed starters and near-static worlds, and compare only the verified paired branches when making intervention contrasts.
acquisition_gate: Align first sustained single-foot support with the immediately preceding raw hip, knee and ankle position and target history.
Compare successful onset and persistent stalls separately in each development cohort. Quantify both directions of support transfer and protect existing starts.

Nominate a causal observable and a single bounded candidate only if the same support transition signature is present across independent cohorts. Freeze new seeds and preserve the original seven-command gate before further physics.
